title: Data Center Maintenance
statementMd:
BigData Inc. is a corporation that has $*n*$ data centers indexed from $1$ to $*n*$ that are located all over the world. These data centers provide storage for client data (you can figure out that client data is really big!).

Main feature of services offered by BigData Inc. is the access availability guarantee even under the circumstances of any data center having an outage. Such a guarantee is ensured by using the *two-way replication*. Two-way replication is such an approach for data storage that any piece of data is represented by two identical copies that are stored in two different data centers.

For each of $*m*$ company clients, let us denote indices of two different data centers storing this client data as $*c*_{*i*, 1}$ and $*c*_{*i*, 2}$.

In order to keep data centers operational and safe, the software running on data center computers is being updated regularly. Release cycle of BigData Inc. is one day meaning that the new version of software is being deployed to the data center computers each day.

Data center software update is a non-trivial long process, that is why there is a special hour-long time frame that is dedicated for data center maintenance. During the maintenance period, data center computers are installing software updates, and thus they may be unavailable. Consider the day to be exactly $*h*$ hours long. For each data center there is an integer $*u*_{*j*}$ ($0 ≤ *u*_{*j*} ≤ *h* - 1$) defining the index of an hour of day, such that during this hour data center $*j*$ is unavailable due to maintenance.

Summing up everything above, the condition $*u*_{*c*_{*i*, 1}} ≠ *u*_{*c*_{*i*, 2}}$ should hold for each client, or otherwise his data may be unaccessible while data centers that store it are under maintenance.

Due to occasional timezone change in different cities all over the world, the maintenance time in some of the data centers may change by one hour sometimes. Company should be prepared for such situation, that is why they decided to conduct an experiment, choosing some non-empty subset of data centers, and shifting the maintenance time for them by an hour later (i.e. if $*u*_{*j*} = *h* - 1$, then the new maintenance hour would become $0$, otherwise it would become $*u*_{*j*} + 1$). Nonetheless, such an experiment should not break the accessibility guarantees, meaning that data of any client should be still available during any hour of a day after the data center maintenance times are changed.

Such an experiment would provide useful insights, but changing update time is quite an expensive procedure, that is why the company asked you to find out the minimum number of data centers that have to be included in an experiment in order to keep the data accessibility guarantees.

## Input

The first line of input contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*h*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100 000$, $2 ≤ *h* ≤ 100 000$), the number of company data centers, number of clients and the day length of day measured in hours.

The second line of input contains $*n*$ integers $*u*_{1}, *u*_{2}, ..., *u*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *u*_{*j*} < *h*$), $*j*$-th of these numbers is an index of a maintenance hour for data center $*j*$.

Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains two integers $*c*_{*i*, 1}$ and $*c*_{*i*, 2}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*, 1}, *c*_{*i*, 2} ≤ *n*$, $*c*_{*i*, 1} ≠ *c*_{*i*, 2}$), defining the data center indices containing the data of client $*i*$.

It is guaranteed that the given maintenance schedule allows each client to access at least one copy of his data at any moment of day.

## Output

In the first line print the minimum possible number of data centers $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$) that have to be included in an experiment in order to keep the data available for any client.

In the second line print $*k*$ distinct integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), the indices of data centers whose maintenance time will be shifted by one hour later. Data center indices may be printed in any order.

If there are several possible answers, it is allowed to print any of them. It is guaranteed that at there is at least one valid choice of data centers.

## Note

Consider the first sample test. The given answer is the only way to conduct an experiment involving the only data center. In such a scenario the third data center has a maintenance during the hour 1, and no two data centers storing the information of the same client have maintenance at the same hour.

On the other hand, for example, if we shift the maintenance time on hour later for the first data center, then the data of clients 1 and 3 will be unavailable during the hour 0.
statementZhMd:
BigData Inc. 是一家在全球各地设有 $*n*$ 个数据中心的公司，这些数据中心的编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。这些数据中心为客户数据提供存储服务（你可以想象到，客户数据真的非常庞大！）。

BigData Inc. 所提供服务的主要特点是：即使任意一个数据中心发生故障，也能保证服务可用。这一保证通过使用*双向复制*来实现。双向复制是一种数据存储方式，其中每份数据都由两个完全相同的副本组成，并分别存储在两个不同的数据中心中。

对于公司的 $*m*$ 个客户中的每一个，记存储该客户数据的两个不同数据中心的编号为 $*c*_{*i*, 1}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*, 2}$。

为了保持数据中心正常运行并确保安全，数据中心计算机上运行的软件会定期更新。BigData Inc. 的发布周期为一天，也就是说每天都会向数据中心的计算机部署新版本的软件。

数据中心软件更新是一个复杂且耗时较长的过程，因此公司专门安排了一个持续一小时的时间段用于数据中心维护。在维护期间，数据中心的计算机正在安装软件更新，因此可能无法使用。设一天恰好有 $*h*$ 小时。对于每个数据中心，都有一个整数 $*u*_{*j*}$（$0 ≤ *u*_{*j*} ≤ *h* - 1$），表示该数据中心 $j$ 因维护而不可用的小时编号。

综上，对于每个客户，都必须满足 $*u*_{*c*_{*i*, 1}} ≠ *u*_{*c*_{*i*, 2}}$，否则当存储其数据的数据中心同时进行维护时，该客户的数据可能无法访问。

由于世界各地不同城市偶尔会发生时区变更，部分数据中心的维护时间有时可能会改变一个小时。为了应对这种情况，公司决定进行一项实验：选择数据中心的某个非空子集，将这些数据中心的维护时间推迟一小时（即如果 $*u*_{*j*} = *h* - 1$，新的维护小时将变为 $0$，否则将变为 $*u*_{*j*} + 1$）。不过，这项实验不能破坏数据可用性保证，也就是说，在维护时间改变后，每个客户的数据在一天中的任何小时都必须仍然可用。

这项实验能够带来有用的信息，但更改更新时间的操作成本很高，因此公司请你找出：为了保证数据可用，实验中至少需要包含多少个数据中心。

## 题目描述

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*h*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100 000$，$2 ≤ *h* ≤ 100 000$），分别表示公司数据中心的数量、客户数量以及一天的小时数。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*u*_{1}, *u*_{2}, ..., *u*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *u*_{*j*} < *h*$），其中第 $*j*$ 个数表示数据中心 $*j*$ 的维护小时编号。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*c*_{*i*, 1}$ 和 $*c*_{*i*, 2}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*, 1}, *c*_{*i*, 2} ≤ *n*$，$*c*_{*i*, 1} ≠ *c*_{*i*, 2}$），表示存储客户 $*i*$ 数据的数据中心编号。

保证给定的维护时间安排能够使每个客户在一天中的任意时刻至少访问到一份其数据副本。

## 输出格式

第一行输出为了保证任意客户的数据可用，实验中必须包含的数据中心的最小数量 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）。

第二行输出 $*k*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示维护时间将被推迟一小时的数据中心编号。数据中心编号可以按任意顺序输出。

如果有多个可行答案，输出其中任意一个即可。保证至少存在一种有效的数据中心选择方案。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例测试。给出的答案是进行包含唯一一个数据中心的实验的唯一方式。在这种情况下，第三个数据中心在小时 $1$ 进行维护，并且存储同一客户信息的两个数据中心不会在同一小时进行维护。

另一方面，例如，如果将第一个数据中心的维护时间推迟一小时，那么客户 $1$ 和客户 $3$ 的数据将在小时 $0$ 无法访问。
